block.title: The C preprocessor runs in Gallina through both OCaml and λANF
block.p: The C preprocessor and its 64-bit #if constant evaluator now live in pure, zero-axiom Gallina in CPp.v, porting c_pp.pl and the pp_value/2 evaluator from c_types.pl. It implements line splicing, comment stripping, preprocessing tokenization, Dave Prosser hide-set macro expansion, # stringification, ## token pasting, variadic macros, conditional stacks, #line remapping, #include and #include_next, __has_include, target feature queries, and #pragma once, push_macro, pop_macro, weak, and pack. File reads, path canonicalization, and target feature queries suspend through a pure resumption type (pp_step) interpreted by main.ml in OCaml and by driver.c in the Fil-C arena binary.

CertiRocq taps the combined preprocessor, lexer, parser, and canonical printer in Drive.v into 6.5 MB of λANF in 18 seconds. AnfLower.v lowers those 3,232 hoisted functions into 1,720 checked nanofil IR functions in 6 seconds. Then nanofil-backend compile-allocated emits 1,362,219 lines of Fil-C x86-64 assembly in 6 seconds and links a 6.6 MB anf-frontend binary in 3 seconds.

On swa, the OCaml extraction matches SWI-Prolog's c_pp.pl byte-for-byte across all 20 Fil-C glibc system headers and all 487 C test fixtures, covering 9,672,404 preprocessed tokens with zero diffs, and matches filcc -E ASTs on all 20 headers. The λANF Fil-C binary matches OCaml byte-for-byte across all 487 C fixtures and all 20 glibc headers. Across the 487-file corpus, full preprocessing and parsing take 133.7 seconds in SWI-Prolog, 41.3 seconds in the λANF Fil-C binary, and 21.2 seconds in OCaml 5.4.1. Running the 20 glibc headers under a 4096-word nursery with FUGC_SCRIBBLE=1 FUGC_VERIFY=1 completed 43,854 minor collections without traps.

claim.p: The extracted OCaml preprocessor matches SWI-Prolog byte-for-byte on the hermetic torture suite (macros, hide sets, 64-bit #if, #line, #include_next, #pragma once, push_macro/pop_macro, weak, pack, and #error) alongside all 487 lex/parse fixtures and 9 C23 fixtures.

Both OCaml and λANF-lowered Fil-C preprocess and parse all 20 Fil-C glibc system headers (35,473 tokens, 2,403 AST items) and all 487 C test fixtures (9.64M tokens, 238,887 AST items) with zero diffs against SWI-Prolog.

metrics.baseline: SWI-Prolog pp+parse on 20 Fil-C glibc headers (35,473 tokens, 2,403 items, swa)
